scope: controlled_world_action_selector_comparison; A-Lab replay remains historical and separate

policy_formulas.HYBRID: 0.8 normalized HIG + 0.8 normalized discovery - 0.8 normalized cost

replay.split_method: deterministic grouped holdout by SHA256(sample_id) parity; no evaluation ID calibrates a model

strongly_falsifying_patterns: failure with high refined target fraction
ambiguous_patterns: near-nominal EDS composition without phase assignment

strongly_supporting_patterns: high EDS spatial variance or segregation
strongly_falsifying_patterns: uniform EDS map with failed outcome
outcome follows phase purity while process is held fixed
ambiguous_patterns: low-resolution SEM with no process metadata
